title: A Multi-Aspect Framework for Counter Narrative Evaluation using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality of LLM-generated counter narratives against hate speech targeting various demographic groups (e.g., LGBT+, immigrants, disabled people, women, and religious groups) using multi-aspect criteria such as specificity, opposition, relatedness, toxicity, and fluency.

Comparing LLM-generated evaluation scores against human (AMT) annotations to identify if an LLM-as-a-judge (e.g., GPT-4) systematically underrates outputs generated by competing models (e.g., Vicuna) due to the outputs being less similar to its own generations.
